company.name: Kigen
company.shortDescription: Kigen is securing the Internet of Things (IoT) and the rise of AI using eSIMs
company.description:
Kigen delivers embedded security solutions for eSIM and iSIM at scale, enabling secure device identity and remote provisioning across 200+ mobile and LPWAN networks. A spin-out from Arm, Kigen supports OEMs and module vendors with GSMA-compliant, security-first IP that accelerates time-to-market for global IoT deployments. Backed by SBI Holdings, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and Arm, Kigen is shaping the future of connected infrastructure with security-first innovation.
https://kigen.com/

productsAndServices.description: A hardware-agnostic operating system for SIM functionality across removable SIM, eSIM, and iSIM form factors, supporting cellular IoT connectivity, security, and Java Card applications.
productsAndServices.name: Kigen SIM OS

productsAndServices.description: GSMA-compliant embedded SIM technology that stores multiple operator profiles and enables secure, remote connectivity management for IoT, consumer, and machine-to-machine devices.
productsAndServices.name: Kigen eSIM

productsAndServices.description: An eSIM IoT Manager for GSMA SGP.32 deployments that manages profile downloads, activation, switching, updates, and auditing across constrained IoT devices and fleets.
productsAndServices.name: Kigen eIM

productsAndServices.description: A GSMA-compliant platform and service for securely generating, hosting, delivering, and managing operator profiles on eSIM-based devices across IoT, M2M, and consumer deployments.
productsAndServices.name: Kigen Remote SIM Provisioning (RSP)

productsAndServices.description: An integrated SIM solution that places SIM functionality and security within a system-on-chip, reducing device size, component count, power use, and manufacturing complexity while supporting remote provisioning.
productsAndServices.name: Kigen iSIM

productsAndServices.description: A factory provisioning solution that securely loads operator profiles onto eSIM- or iSIM-enabled devices during manufacturing, helping OEMs use one global SKU and support offline production environments.
productsAndServices.name: In-Factory Profile Provisioning (IFPP)

aiResearchSummary.text: Kigen is researching connectivity profile provisioning for a secure element by receiving encrypted bound profile packages and securely loading connectivity profiles for mobile network communication. It is also developing methods for provisioning security modules that generate cryptographically authenticated proofs of loading, and systems in which reconfigurable identification modules manage and switch among multiple mobile identity profiles. Together these activities focus on secure element provisioning, security module management, and identity profile control.
